messages:
Jordan: 10 AM catastrophe 
Laptop decided my coffee needed a keyboard baptism. keys sticky but alive. help? :coffee:
Priya: oh no!! first aid: unplug, flip it, blot with paper towel, then let it rest open, 24h. keyboard survivors are a miracle and also require duct tape sometimes.
Hannah: If it's a detachable keyboard you can try rinsing the keys under water (only the caps) and leave the PCB alone. otherwise CL keyswitch swap is also an option for mechanicals.
Leo: timeline of events: 1) scream 2) grab towel 3) try to look calm on video call 4) realize no caps lock anymore.
dev-bot: reminder: Please update your incident report for any workstation-impacting events. Template: "what happened, impact, mitigation, follow-up"
Jordan: fillable later. quick q 
anyone got recommendations for a cheap wireless keyboard that survives latte art?
Priya: I have a Logitech K380 and it's been great. tiny, spill-friendly so far.
Hannah: Corsair K70 here, mechanical and tragic but can replace switches. heavier so cat can't fling it across desk.
Leo: if you want zero drama, go for a silicone-cover keyboard. looks meh but easy to wipe.
Jordan: also, neighbor started drilling at 8:30am. close to a standup. noise cancelling headphones saved my sanity. which ones?
Priya: Sony XM4s. battery god. blocking out jackhammers since 2021.
Hannah: Sennheiser HD 560S here for home studio, wired, comfy for long meetings.
Leo: cheap tip: white noise app + closed windows. also plant placement can muffle sound surprisingly.
Jordan: power blip just after the spill too. laptop battery took over, but worried about slow A/C UPS for my router. suggestions?
dev-bot: infra-alert: if you rely on home routers during releases, consider a small UPS for both router + modem. Estimated cost: $60-$120 for 600VA models.
Priya: I have an APC 600VA. kept my router alive through two outages last winter. worth it.
Hannah: quick PSA: avoid using phone hotspot during heavy deploys unless you like surprise data bills.
Leo: lol true. also, if anyone needs a temporary keyboard, I have an extra at the office (can ship) or can drop by if you're local.
Jordan: thank you all. ordering K380 now. and for the brave, here's my 'after' pic: sticky keys removed, keyboard propped to dry on a tea towel. :grimacing:
Priya: :thumbsup: victory pose when it works again.
Hannah: poll time: where's your ideal WFH spot? react with:
:one: kitchen table
:two: dedicated desk
:three: backyard/patio
:four: cafe
Jordan: :two: (soon-to-be less sticky)
Priya: :one: (compact chaos)
Hannah: :three: if weather cooperates
Leo: :four: only if espresso is reliable
dev-bot: meeting-reminder: team retro at 1600 today. Don't forget to bring your small triumphs (and keyboard war stories).
